लम्बा

LAMBĀ . A daughter of Dakṣaprajāpati. Asiknī wife of Dakṣaprajāpati got a hundred daughters and ten of them were married to Dharmadeva. lambā was one of them. (Chapter 15, Aṁsa 1, viṣṇu purāṇa).

लम्बनी

LAMBANĪ . A follower of subrahmaṇya. (Śloka 18, Chapter 46, śalya Parva).

लम्बपयोधरा

LAMBAPAYODHARĀ . A follower of subrahmaṇya (Śloka 21, Chapter 46, śalya Parva)

लम्पाक

LAMPĀKA . A place of Purāṇic fame. In the great epic battle the people of lampāka fought on the side of the kauravas. They attacked sātyaki and he destroyed the Lampākas. (Śloka 42, Chapter 121, droṇa parva).
